breakdown.description: The two-hole plate is posed in plane stress, but the constitutive relation switches to the unreduced Lamé law
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states to 'Implement plane-stress constitutive response by eliminating σzz and using the resulting 2D stress relation consistent with 3D λ, μ (do not use a plane-strain law).' While it computes the full 3D Lamé parameters, it correctly applies the plane-stress reduction by eliminating σzz, which yields the proper reduced plane-stress constitutive law. This aligns with the ground truth instruction to 'use the reduced plane-stress constitutive law,' and avoids the error of using the unreduced full Lamé λ directly in the 2D weak form as a plane-strain formulation.
